findings.name: Line length too long
findings.description: Text lines wider than ~80 characters are hard to read. The eye loses its place tracking back to the start of the next line. Add a max-width (65ch to 75ch) to text containers.

findings.name: Raster buried under a wash or opacity
findings.description: A background image under a near-opaque gradient wash, or a raster on an element at near-zero opacity, never reaches the screen: the page shows the wash, and the produced texture or photo ships as a compliance token. Let the material show (a tint under 0.9 alpha, a blend mode, an opacity you can see) or remove the file.

findings.detail: 17 cards flush against the left edge of table at rest (1px gap, e.g. th)
findings.name: Cards flush against the scroller edge
findings.description: Cards inside a horizontal scroller or tab panel sit flush against the container edge at rest while keeping a gutter on the other side, so their edges and rounded corners get cut off. Usually the panel is sized wider than its clip box. Keep a consistent inset on both sides.

findings.name: Layout property animation
findings.description: Animating width, height, padding, or margin causes layout thrash and janky performance. Use transform and opacity instead, or grid-template-rows for height animations.
